details: Global equity markets, including the Nasdaq and S&P 500, experienced declines on May 15, 2026, driven by fresh concerns over rising inflation and persistent geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly the US-Iran conflict impacting oil prices. This combination is leading to a "risk-off" sentiment and shifts investor expectations towards the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining or even hiking interest rates. Cryptocurrencies, as risk assets, are also experiencing negative pressure from these macroeconomic and geopolitical factors.

title: Global Markets Decline as Inflation Fears and Middle East Tensions Persist
